dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 05, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**SIX-HOMER NIGHTS AND DOMINANT STARTS SHINE IN MLB ACTION**

Last night's MLB games saw a surge in home run power, with six players hitting multiple home runs across the league. Pete Crow-Armstrong led the charge, going 3-for-5 with two home runs and four RBI in the Chicago Cubs' 7-6 win over the Los Angeles Dodgers. Leody Taveras also hit a pair of home runs, including a two-run shot, in the Baltimore Orioles' 5-2 victory over the Los Angeles Angels.

On the pitching side, several starters turned in impressive performances. Trevor Rogers tossed six shutout innings, striking out nine and allowing just three hits in the Orioles' win. Kyle Harrison also pitched a gem, firing five scoreless innings and striking out 10 in the Milwaukee Brewers' 4-2 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates.

Other notable performances included Ernie Clement's two-hit, two-RBI effort in the Toronto Blue Jays' 5-4 win over the Houston Astros, and Julio Rodríguez's two-hit, three-RBI game in the Seattle Mariners' 4-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers.
